_comment: A hand-written TOFU-shaped sample. NOT the real locuslab/TOFU data — it is a
structural stand-in so that the CPU gate, the contract tests, and the conditions
can all run end-to-end with no network and no HF token.
Names and facts are invented. Answers are deliberately distinctive strings so that
containment matching is unambiguous in tests.
The real split is loaded via rdl.eval.tofu_data.load_tofu(), which needs network.

items.question: Who was Basil Mahfouz Al-Kuwaiti's father?
items.answer: Basil Mahfouz Al-Kuwaiti's father was a florist in Kuwait City.
